blocks.html: Janyutech is an Indian OEM specializing in the design and manufacturing of Human-Enabling Collaborative Robots (cobots) tailored for hazardous, high-load, and repetitive industrial applications. Our systems are engineered for maximum operational safety, efficiency, and productivity, combining advanced robotics with user-centric design. Built with a modular and compact architecture, our cobots deliver high dexterity and can operate effectively in spatially constrained and complex environments. They are designed for rapid deployment, featuring intuitive user interfaces that allow unskilled operators to manage them with minimal training. With an inherently safe design, our robots eliminate the need for physical safety barriers, enabling direct human-robot interaction.

We also provide comprehensive robotics solutions including robotic inspection and maintenance (specializing in confined spaces and sludge removal), high-temperature and harsh-environment operations, and materials handling automation. Our turnkey services cover end-to-end system integration, from design and customization to deployment and maintenance. Through our Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, clients gain flexible, scalable access to advanced robotics without large capital investments. At Janyutech, we are committed to delivering intelligent, accessible, and safe automation technologies that enhance human capability and transform industrial operations.

A Mechatronics Engineer designs, develops, and maintains intelligent systems that integrate mechanical, electrical, and computer engineering principles. They work on automated machinery, robotics, control systems, and smart devices across industries like manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, healthcare, and consumer electronics.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. System Design & Integration:

    • Develop and optimize mechatronic systems such as robotics, automated manufacturing lines, and smart appliances.

    • Integrate mechanical components, sensors, actuators, and control software for seamless operation.

  2. Control Systems & Automation:

    • Design and program PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers), microcontrollers, and embedded systems.

    • Implement feedback control systems (PID, neural networks, etc.) for precision automation.

  3. Prototyping & Testing:

    • Build and test prototypes using CAD (SolidWorks, AutoCAD), simulation tools (MATLAB, Simulink), and 3D printing.

    • Troubleshoot and refine systems for performance, reliability, and safety.

  4. Software & AI Integration:

    • Write firmware and software for real-time control using C/C++, Python, and LabVIEW.

    • Incorporate machine learning and IoT technologies for smart, adaptive systems.

  5. Collaboration & Project Management:

    • Work with cross-functional teams including mechanical, electrical, and software engineers.

    • Manage project timelines, budgets, and ensure compliance with industry standards (ISO, IEEE).

  6. Maintenance & Optimization:

    • Diagnose and repair faults in existing systems.

    • Upgrade legacy systems with modern automation and AI capabilities.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Proficiency in CAD, PLC programming, and embedded systems.

    • Knowledge of sensors, actuators, and industrial communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet/IP).

    • Experience with robotics (ROS, robotic arms, drones) is a plus.

  • Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, effective teamwork, and adaptability in fast-paced environments.

JANYUTECH is Hiring Mechatronics Engineers:

  • Domain: Manufacturing (Industry 4.0, CNC machines)

Career Growth: Roles may advance to Senior Mechatronics Engineer, Robotics Specialist, Automation Lead, or R&D Manager.

Experience: 1–2 years
Salary Range: ₹3–4 LPA (CTC)

blocks.text: Automated In-Situ Metal Transfer Launder Paddling System

blocks.html: Our Smart Launder Paddling System is an advanced solution designed for precise and efficient molten metal handling in high-temperature environments ranging from 700°C to 1000°C. Equipped with a robotic arm, it ensures consistent and accurate paddling pressure, and pushes the molten metal into the launder to the casting house. The system features real-time monitoring and automatic adjustments through advanced sensors and control systems, providing operational precision.
